title: Compiled binary app.bin (2.0 MB, executable) is committed to the repo
evidence:
$ git ls-files | grep -E 'app.bin|game/'
app.bin
$ ls -la
-rwxr-xr-x@  1 moses  staff  2057480  9 Aug 14:39 app.bin
detail: The round briefing names 'committed app.bin binary' a blocker-class item: a platform-specific build artifact in git bloats the repo and bypasses source review. .gitignore ignores bin/ but not app.bin.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin and add app.bin to .gitignore.

title: T1 canonical form omits Health_Meter.in_breach and healthy_streak
evidence:
+	h := &state.health
+	w_i32(&w, h.meter_pct)
+	w_i32(&w, h.grace_ticks_left)
+	w_bool(&w, h.in_grace)
+	w_bool(&w, h.won)
+	w_bool(&w, h.lost)
+	w_u64(&w, h.surge_delivered)
+	w_u64(&w, h.surge_dropped)
+	w_bool(&w, h.prev_in_surge)
detail: §10.2 pins T1 as the hash of the canonical serialized form including rng state + event stream, and the file header claims 'the fingerprint covers ALL sim state'. The E30 hysteresis band state and the refill streak are sim state (health.odin:21-22) and are not serialized.
recommended_fix: Add w_bool(h.in_breach) and w_i32(h.healthy_streak) to state_writer.

title: ODN-5 fail-fast 'named error' output is mangled by the invalid %r fmt verb
evidence: +	return fmt.aprintf("catalog %s: field %r — %s", err.file, err.field, err.rule, allocator = allocator)
detail: ODN-5 requires load failure to 'abort with a named error' (which file, which field, what rule). %r is not an Odin fmt verb; verified on the pinned nightly: it prints %!r(string=field), garbling the diagnostic.

title: Action-log header omits modifiers — E25 requires them 'in the save header from day one'
evidence:
+	w_u32(&w, LOG_MAGIC)
+	w_u32(&w, LOG_VERSION)
+	w_u64(&w, state.seed)
+	w_u8(&w, state.era)
+	w_u64(&w, state.catalogs.hash)
+	w_i32(&w, state.catalogs.balance.logic_hz)
detail: ODN-11/§7.5 pin the header as magic, format_version, seed, era_progress, modifiers[], catalog_hash, logic_hz; §11.7 E25: modifiers 'in the save header from day one'. Adding the field later forces a LOG_VERSION bump and orphans existing goldens.
recommended_fix: Write a modifiers count (0 in PROTO) into the header now, and check it in log_read.

title: Snapshot is a computed projection in one live buffer, not the ODN-1 double-buffered SOA memcpy the spec pins
evidence:
+// PROTO renders at sim rate (the Godot reference's cadence — its vis-dist
+// smoothness is carried as vis_q8), so a single live snapshot rewritten per
+// tick (and topology-only on edit fast-path) replaces the ping-pong pair.
detail: ODN-1/§4: 'Snapshot = memcpy' into double-buffered slots, the view lerps snap[t-1]/snap[t]. The diff builds derived Snap_* structs (lane_caps, ports_used) and rewrites a single live snapshot. Surfaced in comments, but a deviation from 'build EXACTLY to this'.
recommended_fix: Acceptable if explicitly ruled; otherwise double-buffer the snapshot and lerp in the view.

title: E22 pool exhaustion fails the incoming spawn regardless of lane; the spec's lane-ordered shedding is deferred
evidence:
+			if len(f.packets) >= int(cat.balance.packet_pool_cap) {
+				// E22: pool exhaustion — the spawn fails as a drop. (PROTO
+				// shape: fail the incoming spawn. The spec's lane-ordered
+				// shedding is [LATER] — the per-lane queue depth sheds long
+				// before this cap is reached at PROTO scale.)
detail: §11.7 E22 / ODN-8: pool exhaustion drops the lowest-priority lane first. The implementation sheds the incoming spawn for any class; the comment surfaces the deviation itself. Prototype-rigor acceptable; record it.
recommended_fix: No change required for PROTO; track the lane-ordered shed as a [LATER] item.

title: demand_weight catalog knobs are parsed and validated but never read by the sim
evidence: +			append(weights, 1) // demand_weight is uniform in the PROTO roster
detail: 'Balance numbers live in data/*.json, never literals' cuts both ways: packet_types.json and demand.json carry demand_weight values the sim ignores (spawn weighting is uniform). The catalog claims authority it does not have.
recommended_fix: Wire demand_weight into the spawn weighting, or remove the fields from the PROTO schema.
